name: oofui
title_zh: Roblox 界面用 oof/ui 组件拼
tagline_zh: 受够了手搓 Frame 和 UDim2 调半天对不齐？它把 oof/ui 的组件。
tagline_en: Stop hand-tuning Frames and UDim2. Browse oof/ui components, themes and Pro Plus kits, install them via the.
desc_en: Build and refine native Roblox UI with oof/ui in Rojo and React-Luau projects. Discover, install, compose, and theme its components and Pro Plus game kits using the project CLI and verify the result in Roblox Studio.
why_zh: 不是给你一份文档让你自己抄，而是走 CLI 把组件真正落进工程目录，主题和套件按组合方式拼。
why_en: It doesn't hand you docs to copy — the CLI drops real components into your project tree, themes and kits compose together, and.
limit_zh: 只服务 Rojo + React-Luau 工程，纯 Studio 里手搭的界面用不上。
limit_en: Rojo + React-Luau projects only; hand-built Studio UIs won't fit. Components and Pro Plus kits come from the oof/ui ecosystem — anything outside it.
title_en: Build Roblox UI with oof/ui components in Rojo
